absent: Locking discipline for early heap, port operation pointers and boot parameter mutation is not shown.
Numeric encodings of loader flags, encryption flag, minimum alignment, kernel mapping size, page size and control-register bits are not shown.
Decompressor algorithm, ELF parsing details, relocation format and randomized placement policy are not shown.
Serial register offsets, base baud rate, default port and default baud values are not shown.
Complete trampoline code, page-table helpers and remainder of five-level transition after table preparation are not shown.
ACPI discovery procedure, video service contract and console geometry defaults are not shown.

findings.text: extract_kernel is the compressed-stage entry that receives the real-mode parameter block pointer and a destination buffer, prepares console and platform state, chooses placement, validates it, decompresses the payload, cleans up exception state and returns the runtime entry address as destination base plus decoded offset.

decompress_kernel offers a service that ensures the early allocation window is initialized from the embedded heap when empty, runs the generic decompressor over the linked payload into the caller buffer, resolves the entry offset through ELF inspection, applies relocations for the requested virtual base and returns the offset, using the largest unsigned value to report decompression failure.

Memory encryption enablement is decided by counting boolean command line matches for enable versus disable and setting the loader flag only when enable count is larger. Early SEV ES detection clears both text geometry variables to suppress video memory use that would otherwise terminate the guest during second-stage handling and kexec console paths.

On entry the implementation retains the parameter pointer, clears the loader flag reserved for in-kernel use, updates encryption request, sanitizes parameters, selects monochrome or color display memory and control port from the video mode, snapshots text rows and columns, installs default port operations, probes for TDX then SEV, starts console services and stores the ACPI root pointer for later use.

The required contiguous window is the maximum of expanded payload length and total kernel image size, rounded up to minimum kernel alignment on 64 bit. A randomized placement helper chooses output and virtual bases, which are then checked for alignment, heap address limits, containment within the kernel mapping area and fixed-address rule when relocation is disabled, raising a fatal error on violation.

After validation the stage emits progress indications, conditionally accepts unaccepted guest memory covering the destination range, invokes decompression, logs completion with the entry offset, tears down early exception handling, reports any counted spurious early nonmaskable interrupts and returns destination plus offset.
mem_vector describes a memory extent as two 64 bit quantities giving base address followed by length.
efi_type enumerates firmware handoff mode with distinct values for 64 bit, 32 bit and no EFI environment.
Trampoline search honours a low-memory window whose minimum is 128 KiB and maximum is 640 KiB.
Video selection uses mode value 7 to mean monochrome with buffer at 704 KiB and control port 948, otherwise color with buffer at 736 KiB and control port 980.

Default port access dispatches through function pointers to native byte input and byte or word output. Early TDX detection queries the vendor identification leaf and compares three returned words against the expected signature. On match it redirects the pointers to hypercall-backed operations, otherwise it leaves defaults unchanged.

Console bring-up first attempts earlyprintk parsing then falls back to uart8250 console parsing when no serial base is active. Earlyprintk understands a serial keyword with default port, explicit hexadecimal port or ttyS zero or one aliases, plus optional baud with defaults on missing or invalid values. Uart8250 console parsing requires an io-qualified prefix, extracts port and either extracts baud or probes hardware for it.

Serial initialization establishes 8 data bits with one stop bit, disables interrupts and FIFOs, asserts terminal control lines, derives a divisor from the standard base rate divided by desired baud, programs low and high divisor bytes around the latch access bit and records the port as active. Baud probing reads the latched divisor without disturbing line control and divides the base rate by it.

Unsigned string conversion guesses base from leading characters when caller passes zero, treating hex prefix as 16, other leading zero as 8 and otherwise 10, skips an optional hex prefix, then accumulates consecutive valid digits while digit value stays below base and returns the unconsumed suffix through an optional end pointer. Case folding for hex detection uses an OR with 32.

Formatted output composes into a fixed 1 KiB temporary buffer and emits it through the character sink, returning character count. The formatter copies ordinary characters verbatim and interprets conversions with flags for left adjustment, explicit sign, blank sign, alternate form and zero padding, field width and precision from literals or arguments, length modifiers and specifiers for character, string, pointer, store-count, percent, octal, lower or upper hex and signed or unsigned decimal, emitting unknown sequences literally.

Decimal prefix parsing accumulates consecutive digit values. Numeric rendering supports only bases 8, 10 and 16, normalizes conflicting padding flags, accounts for sign and alternate prefixes in width, converts magnitude by repeated unsigned divide and remainder using a 66 byte scratch area with uppercase digit table optionally folded to lower case, then emits leading spaces, sign, prefix, padding, zero fill, digits and trailing spaces.

Character output iterates over a string, expands each newline into carriage return plus newline, always calls the BIOS teletype path with fixed display attributes through interrupt 16 and also writes to the serial port when configured. Serial transmission waits with a bounded loop for transmitter readiness while relaxing the processor, then writes the byte. BIOS path initializes registers and invokes the video service.

The host packing tool validates its argument count, opens the compressed payload, seeks to its four byte trailer to obtain uncompressed length with little-endian decoding, uses current file position as compressed length, then prints assembler directives defining compressed length, uncompressed length and embedded binary symbols in read-only sections before closing the file.

Trampoline placement skips firmware signature probing on EFI boots and otherwise reads low-memory size indicators from BIOS data area, clamps the candidate top to the allowed window, aligns it down to page size and walks the firmware memory map from high to low entries to find a RAM extent below the candidate that can contain the trampoline with page alignment and underflow protection, finally returning a location just below the chosen top. A static buffer sized for the trampoline preserves overwritten bytes during use.

Paging mode selection sanitizes parameters, treats absence of the disable option together with processor support and feature indication as a request for five-level paging, records the mode in global control variables, returns immediately when hardware state already matches the request and otherwise allocates low-memory trampoline space, saves existing contents, clears the area, copies in mode-switch code, adjusts its absolute jump target for the chosen address and builds a transitional top table by wrapping the current root for upgrade or by copying the nested root for downgrade.

Build configurations without relocation choice, console, ACPI, exception handling, unaccepted memory, debug output or TDX support replace the corresponding helpers with empty inline variants that do nothing or return neutral zero or false values.

Placement hazards include misaligned physical or virtual bases, heap addresses beyond the supported range, virtual ranges extending past the kernel mapping area and unexpected virtual movement for non-relocatable builds, each treated as fatal. Decompression failure, missing memory acceptance and trampoline selection that underflows or collides with reserved low memory risk boot failure or firmware corruption. Serial baud probing performs division by the latched divisor and therefore requires a nonzero value.

Header guards and build sentinels mark inclusion of compressed-stage, character-type and boot-parameter helpers and disable hardening where unsupported while selecting the five-level early table layout. An address helper reinterprets an integer as a pointer. An integer alias adapts to build width. In the compressed stage the serial base is a fixed placeholder indicating no legacy serial variable. Decimal and hexadecimal diagnostic helpers alias to common numeric emitters when enabled.
